capabilities: Chat with Claude in a streaming sidebar
Attach notes explicitly to set what the model can see
Review and apply suggested edits as line-by-line diffs
Enforce allowlist, denylist, and frontmatter opt-out rules
extras: Not yet publicly released (v0.1 M1, manual install only); Anthropic-only by design, no multi-provider support; manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; usage billed to the user's own Anthropic account.
motivation: The author built it around the idea that "an AI assistant in your vault must be default-deny" — nothing is read or written without explicit user action.
problem: AI assistants in Obsidian typically read broadly or write automatically, so users lack strict control over exactly what content leaves the vault and what gets changed.

relations.evidence: requests go directly from the plugin to api.anthropic.com using your own API key

summary: Privacy-first Claude chat sidebar that only sends notes you explicitly attach and applies suggested edits through per-hunk diff review.
